title: LV service connection - 14 Banksia Street, Penrith
summary: Live LV work is discussed with PPE only. CrewBrief asks about isolation, the crew answers, and the blocking gap closes. Shows off-topic and passer-by speech being ignored.

lines.speaker: u-crew-1
lines.text: Righto, morning all. Sam here, leading hand today. Let's do the pre-job brief before we get stuck in.

lines.speaker: u-crew-1
lines.text: Job is a new LV service connection off pole PEN 3302 at 14 Banksia Street, Penrith. Work order 4471823.

lines.speaker: u-crew-2
lines.text: Yep. We're working on live LV at the pole, the mains are energised and there's no outage for one service.

lines.speaker: u-crew-1
lines.text: So arc flash suits on, insulating gloves and face shields for the whole connection.

lines.speaker: u-crew-3
lines.text: Did anyone catch the footy last night? Panthers were robbed.

lines.speaker: u-crew-1
lines.text: Priya, you're in the EWP for the connection, harness on and clipped in, and I've checked the pre-start.

lines.speaker: u-crew-3
lines.text: I'll be the safety observer on the ground and I'll put cones and signs out on the footpath for pedestrians.

lines.speaker: u-crew-2
lines.text: There's a dog in the yard next door, so the owner's going to keep it inside while we're here.

lines.speaker: u-crew-1
lines.text: Emergency. Muster point is the corner of Banksia and Wattle by the post box. Nearest hospital is Nepean Hospital.

lines.speaker: u-crew-3
lines.text: I'm the first aider, kit's in the truck. Comms is mobile and the radio on channel six.

lines.speaker: u-crew-1
lines.text: Good point. We'll pull the service fuses and tag them, test before touch to prove it dead, then apply earths before anyone touches the service.

lines.speaker: u-crew-2
lines.text: And insulating covers on the LV mains next to the connection point.

lines.speaker: u-crew-1
lines.text: Righto, anything else? No? Let's sign on and get going.
